kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi add-sms-template --template-type 0 --template-name '验证码' --template-content '您正在申请手机注册，验证码为：_code_，5分钟内有效！' --remark '申请验证码短信' --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddSmsTemplate

parameters.help_en:
The SMS type. Valid values:

0: authenticate.
1: SMS notification.
2: promotional SMS.
3: international/Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan message.

Only users who verify your identity - Enterprise account can apply for promotional SMS messages and international/Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan messages. For details about the differences between individual and enterprise user privileges, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55324.html
parameters.help_zh:
短信类型。取值：

0：验证码。
1：短信通知。
2：推广短信。
3：国际/港澳台消息。

仅支持企业认证用户申请推广短信和国际/港澳台消息。个人用户与企业用户权益区别详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/55324.html
parameters.name: template_type

parameters.help_en: The template name. The name can be up to 30 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 模板名称，长度不超过30个字符
parameters.name: template_name

parameters.example: 您正在申请手机注册，验证码为：${code}，5分钟内有效！
parameters.help_en:
The template content. The content can be up to 500 characters in length.

The template content and variable content must comply with the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/463161.html. Otherwise, the template will fail the review. You can also view common template examples on the Apply for template (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template/add) page. Using example templates can improve the review efficiency and approval rate. For more information about variable specifications, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2806243.html
parameters.help_zh:
模板内容，长度不超过500个字符。

模板内容和变量内容必须符合https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/463161.html，否则模板会审核失败。您也可以在申请模板 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/template/add)页面，查看常用模板示例。使用示例模板可提高审核效率和成功率。变量规范请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2806243.html
parameters.name: template_content

parameters.help_en:
The description of the SMS template application. The description can be up to 100 characters in length.

The description serves as reference information for template review. A complete description helps reviewers understand your business scenario and improves review efficiency. Guidelines:

Provide the usage scenario of your launched business.
Provide real-scenario SMS examples that reflect your business scenario.
Provide the parameter values of variables and describe the business scenario and the reason for selecting the variable attributes in detail.
Provide the website link, ICP-filed domain name, or app marketplace download link of your actual business.
For logon scenarios, provide a test account and password
parameters.help_zh:
短信模板申请说明，长度不超过100个字符。

模板审核的参考信息，完善申请说明有助于审核人员理解您的业务场景，提高审核效率。填写指导：

您可以提供已上线业务的使用场景。
您可以提供真实场景的短信示例，体现您的业务场景。
您可以提供变量的传参内容，详细描述业务使用场景和选择这个变量属性的原因。
您可以提供实际业务的网站链接、已备案的域名地址、应用市场下载链接等。
登录场景，您可以提供测试账号和密码
parameters.name: remark

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

TemplateCode.description_en:
The SMS template code.

After you submit a template application, you can use the SMS template code to call the [QuerySmsTemplate]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419289.html） operation to query the template review details. You can also [configure receipt messages]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101508.html） and obtain the template review status through [TemplateSmsReport]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120999.html）
TemplateCode.description_zh:
短信模板Code。

提交模板申请后，您可以使用短信模板Code，通过[QuerySmsTemplate]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/419289.html）接口查询模板审核详情。也可以[配置回执消息]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101508.html），通过[TemplateSmsReport]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/120999.html）获取模板的审核状态消息
